entities.span: **The v1 completion test.** v1 is done when a user can enter a profile, search, see ranked results with the reasoning shown, click through to apply, and record that they applied. Check every proposed addition against this, not against whether it is individually reasonable. **Met and confirmed in production 2026-09-17; v1 is complete.**
entities.label: The v1 completion test

entities.span: **The named risk retention rule.** Anything in scope because of a specific named real risk (features 10 and 7 here) is removed only by explicitly deciding that risk is acceptable, never as a side effect of trimming for time.
entities.label: The named risk retention rule

entities.span: **Search results never persist.** Only an applied record, and later a discard, makes a job stick.
rejected_spans: This is what avoids a staleness state machine.

entities.span: Accepted trade off: jobs merely seen but not acted on are not deduplicated against, deliberately,
rejected_spans: to avoid a growing seen jobs ledger

entities.span: **No silent failures anywhere.** A failed fetch, a failed auth check or a failed scoring call is visible, never swallowed into a default that looks like success.
entities.label: No silent failures anywhere

entities.span: **Real dependency tests.** Every external dependency gets at least one test that actually calls it or replays a real recorded response, never a mock encoding the same assumption as the code under test.
entities.label: Real dependency tests

entities.span: **Quality, not just shape.** Anything that scores, ranks or generates needs expected ranges, not only schema validation.
rejected_spans: A schema check proves shape, not usefulness.
entities.label: Quality, not just shape

entities.span: **Raw in, formatted at render.** Store raw values;
rejected_spans: a formatted string frozen into a column cannot be fixed by fixing the formatter.
entities.label: Raw in, formatted at render

entities.span: **Cross model review before merge**, and cross vendor self check inside the AI pipeline: the same principle at two layers.
**Fixtures never carry real personal data.** Obviously fake identifiers only, even for convenience.
entities.label: Fixtures never carry real personal data

entities.span: **No billing.** Cost exposure is handled by usage gating, not monetization.
entities.label: No billing

entities.span: **Responsive throughout, designed desktop first**, and WCAG 2.2 AA on the v1 loop.
**Write the data and control flow from memory** at the end of each feature before calling it done.
rejected_spans: Understanding erodes silently under scope pressure, and a stated intention does not catch that.
